executive_summary: Create the venture AI organization before UAT, QA/QC it at stage 23 (dedicated_venture_uat) alongside the product UAT via the acceptance suite already built this session, surface both results at stage 24 (launch_readiness_gate), and block launch if the organization fails QA/QC. Implemented entirely within the 2 existing stage-template files -- no new stage number, no chairman-gated renumber ceremony.

functional_requirements.requirement: In lib/eva/stage-templates/analysis-steps/stage-23-dedicated-venture-uat.js (live DB stage 23), before or alongside the existing checkUatRobustnessGate() call, create a draft AI organization for the venture via VentureFactory.instantiateVenture({ventureId, ventureName, ...}) (lib/agents/venture-ceo-factory.js) if one does not already exist for this venture (checked via agent_registry/org_agent_identities, or by catching VentureNotFoundError-adjacent state -- the venture itself is guaranteed to exist at stage 23, so instantiateVenture()'s own existence guard, SD-LEO-INFRA-INSTANTIATEVENTURE-REFUSES-VENTURE-001, will not fire under normal operation).
functional_requirements.description: Matches this file's own established pattern (already calls generateLegalDocsForVenture() as a side effect that 'never blocks or alters this stage's own UAT verdict'). Org creation must be idempotent -- calling this stage-23 step twice for the same venture must not create a second organization.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A mock venture with no prior organization gets one created by the time stage 23's analysis step completes.
AC-2: Calling the stage-23 step a second time for the same venture does not create a duplicate organization (idempotent -- checked before create).

AC-3: Organization creation failure (e.g. a thrown error from instantiateVenture()) does not throw out of the stage-23 step -- caught and recorded, mirroring generateLegalDocsForVenture()'s own never-throws contract, surfaced via eva_orchestration_events.

functional_requirements.requirement: Immediately after organization creation (or confirming one already exists), run the organization acceptance suite (lib/org/acceptance-suite/run-suite.mjs's runSuite(), SD-LEO-INFRA-ORGANIZATION-ACCEPTANCE-SUITE-001) against the venture's organization, and append ONE new entry to analyzeStage23DedicatedVentureUat()'s own RETURNED `artifacts` array (a new ARTIFACT_TYPES.ORGANIZATION_QA_RESULT constant, lib/eva/artifact-types.js) -- NOT a direct venture_artifacts insert. The step never calls supabase.from('venture_artifacts') itself; per direct code reading, this analysis step returns `{..., artifacts: [{artifactType, title, payload, source, metadata, runId}]}` and the caller (writeArtifactBatch(), lib/eva/artifact-persistence-service.js) is what actually performs the insert AND the is_current dedup (marks prior is_current rows false, scoped per artifact_type, before inserting the new batch) -- exactly matching how the existing LAUNCH_UAT_REPORT entry in this same array already works.
functional_requirements.description: This is the stage-23 half of the SD's success criteria: 'stage 23 records an organization QA/QC result... next to the product UAT result.' PLAN-phase self-review caught an initial draft of this FR that implied a direct venture_artifacts write -- corrected after reading the actual stage-23 handler's return shape and confirming writeArtifactBatch()'s is_current dedup logic (artifact-persistence-service.js:432-439) directly. The payload carries the suite's {suite_version, run_id, content_hash, pass_rate, catch_rate, findings[]} shape verbatim (no reformatting), so provenance is traceable back to the exact suite version that ran.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: analyzeStage23DedicatedVentureUat()'s returned artifacts array contains a second entry (artifactType: ARTIFACT_TYPES.ORGANIZATION_QA_RESULT) alongside the existing LAUNCH_UAT_REPORT entry, with payload equal to runSuite()'s verbatim output.

AC-2: After writeArtifactBatch() processes this stage's artifacts, a venture_artifacts row with artifact_type=ORGANIZATION_QA_RESULT, is_current=true exists, ALONGSIDE (not replacing) the existing UAT robustness artifact -- both present, both is_current=true (writeArtifactBatch's dedup is scoped per artifact_type, so the 2 types coexist).

AC-3: Running stage 23 again for the same venture relies on writeArtifactBatch()'s existing dedup (prior is_current rows for this artifact_type marked false before the new insert) -- no bespoke dedup logic written in this SD's own code.

functional_requirements.requirement: New REQUIRED checklist category 'organization_qa' added to lib/eva/quality-model/registry.js's dimension list (following the exact entry shape of 'legal': id, name, tier, owner_stage:23, producer pointing at the new FR-1/FR-2 step, reader_or_gate pointing at stage-23-launch-readiness.js, severity_policy:'blocking', stage23_membership:'required', applicability, ratification_pointer, waiver:null), and a corresponding case 'organization_qa' in stage-23-launch-readiness.js's (live DB stage 24) scoring switch -- reading the FR-2 artifact directly (preflight.artifactData.get('organization_qa_result'), mirroring the 'legal' case's dedicated-check pattern, NOT the upstream-preflight anyOf pattern used for S20-S22 cross-stage deps) and scoring status='pass' only when the suite's overall pass_rate/catch_rate indicate a clean run, 'fail' otherwise with the specific failing check(s) named in detail.
functional_requirements.description: This is the stage-24 half of the SD's success criteria: 'the stage-24 launch-readiness packet shows both... a venture whose organization fails QA/QC cannot pass stage 24.' Reusing the exact registry+switch mechanism every other blocking category already uses, rather than a parallel gate.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A venture whose FR-2 artifact shows a clean acceptance-suite run scores organization_qa='pass' at stage 24.

AC-2: A venture whose FR-2 artifact shows one or more failing acceptance-suite checks scores organization_qa='fail' at stage 24, and the overall stage-24 checklist verdict is not PASS (organization_qa is REQUIRED/blocking, matching 'legal').

AC-3: A venture with NO FR-2 artifact at all (organization creation never ran, e.g. a pre-existing in-flight venture) scores organization_qa as a defined pending/fail state, never silently 'pass' -- absence must never read as success.

functional_requirements.requirement: The organization created and QA/QC'd at stage 23 remains entirely mock/rehearsal -- no agent it creates takes any real action, sends any outbound communication, or is switched on for live operation before stage 25 (go_live). This SD does not build the go-live activation switch itself (out of scope, a separate later item); it only guarantees the stage-23/24 creation-and-QA/QC path never activates anything.
functional_requirements.description: Directly implements the SD's own 'nothing in it runs before go-live' requirement and chairman ruling 90c0b40a's standing mock-first discipline. VentureFactory.instantiateVenture() itself only writes registry/identity rows -- it has no code path that dispatches a live agent action, so this requirement is satisfied by construction as long as FR-1/FR-2 call only instantiateVenture()/runSuite() and nothing else.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A test confirms that after stage 23 runs, zero rows exist in any outbound-communication or agent-action-log table attributable to the newly created organization.
AC-2: git diff for this SD's FR-1/FR-2 code touches no publisher/outreach/communication-dispatch module.

technical_requirements.requirement: No new database table and no new venture_stages row -- this SD adds one new artifact_type constant, one new registry entry, and new logic inside 2 existing stage-template files.
technical_requirements.rationale: R1 (chairman ratification bb2175d2 / the standing new-table ceremony rule) does not apply; this SD writes to the existing venture_artifacts table with a new artifact_type value, exactly as every other stage-template producer does.

technical_requirements.requirement: Organization creation (FR-1) and the acceptance-suite run (FR-2) must both be wrapped in try/catch that never lets a thrown error propagate out of the stage-23 analysis step -- mirroring the exact pattern this file already uses for generateLegalDocsForVenture() (try/catch around the call, logger.warn on throw, a structured {ok:false, reason:'threw', error} result substituted in place of a real result) rather than inventing a new error-handling shape.
technical_requirements.rationale: A stage-template analysis step throwing would block the ENTIRE stage 23 pipeline for reasons unrelated to the venture's actual UAT outcome -- this SD's new logic must never become a new source of stage-23 instability. Reusing the file's own established catch-and-substitute pattern (not a fresh design) keeps the new code consistent with its neighbor.

technical_requirements.requirement: FR-1/FR-2's org-creation-and-QA/QC result is delivered ONLY via analyzeStage23DedicatedVentureUat()'s own returned `artifacts` array (a second entry alongside the existing LAUNCH_UAT_REPORT entry) -- this SD's code never calls supabase.from('venture_artifacts') directly. The actual insert and is_current dedup are writeArtifactBatch()'s (lib/eva/artifact-persistence-service.js) existing responsibility.
technical_requirements.rationale: PLAN-phase self-review found and corrected a draft of FR-2 that implied a direct DB write, which would have duplicated (and risked diverging from) writeArtifactBatch()'s own dedup logic. Confirmed by direct code reading of both the stage-23 handler's return shape and writeArtifactBatch()'s is_current handling (artifact-persistence-service.js:432-439) before writing this requirement.

technical_requirements.requirement: The new registry entry and switch case follow the 'legal' category's pattern exactly (a dedicated artifact-presence-and-content check), not the UPSTREAM_REQUIREMENTS anyOf pattern (S20-S22 cross-stage deps) -- organization_qa has exactly one producer (this SD's own FR-1/FR-2 step) and no legacy/alternate artifact_type to accept.

system_architecture.overview: Two new pieces of logic inside 2 existing, already-large stage-template files, plus one new registry entry and one new artifact-type constant. No new stage, table, or service.

components.name: Organization-creation-and-QA/QC step (new logic in stage-23-dedicated-venture-uat.js)
components.responsibility: Creates the venture's AI organization (if absent) and runs the organization acceptance suite against it, writing the result as a venture_artifacts row.
components.technology: Reuses VentureFactory.instantiateVenture() (lib/agents/venture-ceo-factory.js) and runSuite() (lib/org/acceptance-suite/run-suite.mjs) -- both existing, unmodified.

components.name: 'organization_qa' registry entry (new entry in lib/eva/quality-model/registry.js)
components.responsibility: Declares the new checklist category as REQUIRED/blocking, with producer/reader_or_gate pointers per the Venture Quality Model v1 shape.
components.technology: Existing registry pattern, no new mechanism.

components.name: 'organization_qa' scoring case (new case in stage-23-launch-readiness.js)
components.responsibility: Reads the FR-2 artifact and scores pass/fail at the launch-readiness checklist (live DB stage 24), gating the kill-gate verdict.
components.technology: Existing checklist switch pattern, no new mechanism.

system_architecture.data_flow: Venture reaches stage 23 -> new step checks for an existing organization, creates one via instantiateVenture() if absent -> runs runSuite() against it -> appends a second entry (ARTIFACT_TYPES.ORGANIZATION_QA_RESULT) to the step's own returned `artifacts` array, alongside the existing LAUNCH_UAT_REPORT entry -> the stage's caller passes this array to writeArtifactBatch(), which performs the actual venture_artifacts insert + is_current dedup (existing mechanism, unmodified) -> venture reaches stage 24 -> launch-readiness checklist's new 'organization_qa' case reads that artifact via preflight.artifactData -> scores pass/fail -> feeds the overall kill-gate verdict exactly as every other REQUIRED category does.
integration_points: lib/agents/venture-ceo-factory.js's VentureFactory.instantiateVenture() (read/write: creates org rows, unmodified by this SD)
lib/org/acceptance-suite/run-suite.mjs's runSuite() (read-only: evaluates the org, unmodified by this SD)

lib/eva/artifact-persistence-service.js's writeArtifactBatch() (existing artifact-write + is_current-dedup mechanism, unmodified by this SD -- this SD only adds an entry to the artifacts array passed into it)
venture_artifacts table (new artifact_type value, existing table/columns, written only via writeArtifactBatch())

test_scenarios.scenario: A mock venture with no prior organization gets one created at stage 23
test_scenarios.given: A mock venture entering stage 23 with no agent_registry/org_agent_identities rows
test_scenarios.then: An organization exists for the venture, and a venture_artifacts row (organization_qa_result) is written

test_scenarios.given: A venture whose organization was already created by a prior stage-23 run
test_scenarios.when: The stage-23 analysis step runs again
test_scenarios.then: No duplicate organization is created -- instantiateVenture() is not called a second time (or is called and correctly no-ops), verified via a spy/mock

test_scenarios.scenario: A clean organization passes the stage-24 organization_qa category
test_scenarios.given: A venture_artifacts row (organization_qa_result) showing a 100%-pass acceptance-suite run
test_scenarios.when: The stage-24 launch-readiness checklist scores the organization_qa category

test_scenarios.scenario: A defective organization (seeded MAST fixture) fails the stage-24 organization_qa category and blocks the checklist
test_scenarios.given: A venture_artifacts row (organization_qa_result) showing a failing acceptance-suite check
test_scenarios.when: The stage-24 launch-readiness checklist scores the organization_qa category
test_scenarios.then: status='fail', and the overall checklist verdict is not PASS

test_scenarios.scenario: A venture with no organization_qa_result artifact never silently passes
test_scenarios.given: A venture reaching stage 24 with no organization_qa_result venture_artifacts row
test_scenarios.when: The stage-24 checklist scores the organization_qa category
test_scenarios.then: status is a defined pending/fail state, never 'pass'

test_scenarios.scenario: Organization creation/QA-QC never throws out of the stage-23 step
test_scenarios.given: instantiateVenture() or runSuite() mocked to throw
test_scenarios.then: The step completes without throwing, and the failure is surfaced via eva_orchestration_events, matching generateLegalDocsForVenture()'s existing contract

test_scenarios.scenario: Nothing about the created organization is live before go-live
test_scenarios.given: A venture that has passed stage 23 and stage 24 with a clean organization_qa result
test_scenarios.when: Any outbound-communication or agent-action-log table is queried for that organization
test_scenarios.then: Zero rows exist -- the organization has taken no real action

acceptance_criteria: A mock venture's organization is created before stage 23 completes (idempotently).
Stage 23 records an organization QA/QC result (the acceptance suite) alongside the existing product UAT result, as a venture_artifacts row.
The stage-24 launch-readiness packet's checklist includes a new REQUIRED 'organization_qa' category reading that result.
A venture whose organization fails QA/QC cannot pass the stage-24 kill gate.
Nothing about the created organization runs/activates before go-live (stage 25) -- verified by an integration test.
No new stage number, table, or chairman ceremony -- this SD's diff is confined to the 2 existing stage-template files, the registry file, and the artifact-types file.

risks.risk: The scoping decision to implement within existing stages (rather than await Solomon's stage-placement call) could be revisited if Solomon later decides organization-creation warrants a dedicated stage number.
risks.mitigation: This SD's artifact/registry contract (organization_qa_result artifact_type, the registry entry shape) is stage-number-agnostic -- if a dedicated stage is later created, the producer logic can move into a new stage-template file without changing the artifact contract this SD establishes. Already flagged to the coordinator (spec-conflict signal 7ab3945a) for awareness.
risks.rollback_plan: If Solomon's eventual decision conflicts with this implementation, the new registry entry/switch case can be feature-flagged off (mirroring GROWTH_FLAG_KEY/CAPABILITY_CHECKLIST_FLAG_KEY's existing default-OFF rollout pattern) without reverting the underlying artifact-writing logic.

risks.risk: Adding a new REQUIRED/blocking category to an already-complex launch-readiness checklist could unexpectedly flip in-flight ventures from READY to HOLD if they have no organization yet.
risks.mitigation: Per the existing rollout-safety pattern in this same file (LEO_S21_GROWTH_PLAYBOOK_REQUIRED, LEO_S24_CAPABILITY_CHECKLIST_REQUIRED, both default OFF), the new organization_qa category should ship behind a similar feature flag, default OFF, so no existing in-flight venture's checklist/verdict changes until explicitly enabled.
risks.rollback_plan: Flip the flag off; the checklist reverts to its pre-SD behavior immediately (no code revert needed).

risks.risk: This SD depends on 2 other SDs completed earlier this same session (instantiateVenture guard, organization acceptance suite) -- if either has an undiscovered defect, this SD inherits it.
risks.mitigation: Both dependency SDs went through their own full LEAD-PLAN-EXEC-VERIFY cycle with adversarial review this session and are merged to main with passing CI; this SD's own EXEC-phase testing will exercise both through this SD's own new integration code paths, providing an additional layer of coverage.

consumers.name: stage-23-launch-readiness.js's launch-readiness checklist (live DB stage 24)
consumers.interaction: Reads the FR-2 artifact via the new organization_qa case, feeding the overall kill-gate verdict.

dependencies.name: VentureFactory.instantiateVenture() (lib/agents/venture-ceo-factory.js)
dependencies.contract: Creates an organization for a valid venture id; throws VentureNotFoundError for a nonexistent one (not expected to fire here, since stage 23 always has a real venture).
dependencies.failure_handling: Wrapped in try/catch (TR-2) -- a thrown error is caught, logged via eva_orchestration_events, and does not block the rest of stage 23.

dependencies.name: runSuite() (lib/org/acceptance-suite/run-suite.mjs)
dependencies.contract: Evaluates an organization object against the MAST-seeded acceptance checks, returns {suite_version, run_id, content_hash, pass_rate, catch_rate, findings[]}.
dependencies.failure_handling: Wrapped in try/catch (TR-2), same contract as instantiateVenture() above; the suite's own internal design (built this session) already degrades content_hash to null on error rather than throwing, so a thrown error here would be a genuine infrastructure failure, not a normal evaluation outcome.

data_contracts.name: venture_artifacts row, artifact_type='organization_qa_result'
data_contracts.shape: Verbatim runSuite() output: {suite_version, run_id, content_hash, pass_rate, catch_rate, findings[]}, plus standard venture_artifacts columns (venture_id, lifecycle_stage, is_current, created_at).

feature_flags: A new default-OFF flag (e.g. LEO_S24_ORGANIZATION_QA_REQUIRED) gating whether the organization_qa category is REQUIRED/blocking vs. absent from the checklist entirely -- mirrors LEO_S21_GROWTH_PLAYBOOK_REQUIRED/LEO_S24_CAPABILITY_CHECKLIST_REQUIRED's existing rollout pattern.
runtime_config.deployment_considerations: No migration. The new artifact_type value requires no schema change (venture_artifacts.artifact_type has no enum constraint, confirmed by the existing pattern of adding new artifact types without migrations).

monitoring: eva_orchestration_events entries for any FR-1/FR-2 failure (subtype pattern matching legal_producer_failed)
observability_rollout.rollout_strategy: Merge with the new feature flag default OFF (checklist unaffected for all in-flight ventures); flag enabled explicitly once the clean-slate test venture (ratification 3c4a6781) is ready to exercise this path, per chairman ruling 212909b9's stated sequencing.
observability_rollout.rollback_trigger: The organization_qa category incorrectly blocking a venture that should legitimately pass.
observability_rollout.rollback_procedure: Flip the feature flag OFF; no code revert needed.
